name: Other armed conflicts
summary: Pakistan strikes Afghan Taliban border posts; Moyale fighting sends 50,000 into Kenya
state: Pakistan said it struck several Afghan Taliban border posts on 1–2 Nov after cross-border fire, and tensions flared again near Torkham (Afghanistan International; Tempo). In Ethiopia, fighting in Moyale has driven more than 50,000 people into Kenya, where UN agencies seek about Sh1bn in aid (Nation). Neither is an interstate war or an attack on a capital.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Afghanistan, Pakistan's border areas and southern Ethiopia.
rubric_hit: Significant deterioration in untracked conflicts = Watch

sources.title: Afghanistan International — Strikes carried out on several Taliban border posts, says Pakistan
Nation — Moyale crisis: UN agencies seek Sh1bn as refugees hit 50,000

why: Wars and flashpoints outside Canary's named list — such as Yemen, Haiti, Ethiopia–Eritrea, Afghanistan–Pakistan, Libya and Somalia — can escalate with little warning.
drivers: Coups, border clashes, insurgencies, state collapse, outside intervention.
